title: The orientation and the mission dispatch still allow a background wait, and no smoke scenario exercises one
details:
The decision recorded on SAC-067 has two parts that did not land with its fix at f06d9ee.

First, the orchestrator's own instructions should say to call `wait` in the foreground. The orientation, `internal/cli/assets/orientation.md.tmpl`, and the mission dispatch in `internal/cli/create.go` say only "Never end your turn without either calling `wait` or replying". A wait launched as a background task, followed by the end of the turn, obeys that sentence. Both texts reach the model inside the requests the cassettes under `test/cassettes/` recorded, so editing either makes every recorded scenario miss. The change needs every scenario re-recorded against real providers.

Second, the smoke tier has no fault scenario in which the orchestrator waits in the background and its wake never comes. That scenario would prove the idle-orchestrator rule of SPEC.md R64 end to end. Recording it costs a real campaign too.

Until both land, the rule catches an orchestrator that waits in the background, and PLAYBOOK.md tells the operator to brief foreground waiting. Nothing tells the orchestrator itself.
